# Noto Sans CJK SC

`NotoSansCJKsc-Regular.otf` is the regular Simplified Chinese OpenType font from [notofonts/noto-cjk](https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk/tree/main/Sans/OTF/SimplifiedChinese). The font is used for server-rendered ledger images. Its SIL Open Font License is included in `OFL.txt`.
